name: SetScreenResolution
label: Set Screen Resolution
description: Sets the width, height, bit count, and frequency of a selected monitor.

fields.name: Display
fields.label: Display
fields.description: The name or number of the display to set resolution for. Use 'Primary' for the primary monitor, or 'All' for all monitors.

fields.name: BitCount
fields.label: Bit Count
fields.description: The bit count of the screen.

fields.name: Frequency
fields.label: Frequency
fields.description: The frequency (refresh rate) of the screen.
